scope: Polished Linux/Windows/macOS GUI and supported tray/menu-bar hosts are clients of one routing runtime. First batch adds no GUI/webview dependencies.

cases.steps: Create at least four arbitrary named mixes, rename one, route the same mix to two physical devices plus a virtual consumer, independently adjust each output, then select per-device primary/all-routed/OS-default control modes.
cases.expect: GUI/tray/CLI agree on stable IDs, revision, user names and every output edge with no preset/count cap or silent endpoint truncation. Show per-device clock/gap/degraded status and global player-pause versus device-local output-mute scope. Renames preserve IDs. Unsupported event attribution/state/capability and preflight capacity errors remain visible.

cases.steps: Under simultaneous call+record+monitor continuous nonrepeating PCM capture, close all GUI windows and reopen the app. Repeat for tray/menu-bar quit-UI versus explicit stop-runtime actions.
cases.expect: GUI closure does not stop samples or rebuild stable routes. Reopening reflects the same runtime desired/observed state. Explicit runtime stop is visibly distinct and measured as an intentional interruption. Verify no gaps, leaks, clicks or reset gains, not merely process survival.

cases.steps: On each supported OS build/install/run the CLI without GUI package, display session or webview runtime installed. Exercise plan/status/devices/diagnostics and later explicit route/gain/mute operations via documented JSON outputs. Record exact environment and dependencies.
cases.expect: CLI remains usable independently; no display/webview loading, GUI process dependency or second audio graph. Missing native permission/dependency gives explicit nonzero/degraded result. Hosted core compilation alone does not prove the no-webview installation gate.

cases.steps: Simultaneously change different sends through CLI and tray/menu-bar, then race updates to the same send; reconnect both clients while capturing audio and state/events.
cases.expect: One runtime applies a defined ordering; both clients converge to the same authoritative revision/gains/mutes/device UIDs with no stale overwrite or competing graph. Samples and untouched sends remain correct. Record supported desktop/tray host and OS/app versions.

cases.steps: Compare status for configured but absent source, discovered/connected source with no audio proof, permission denial, lost virtual transport, and externally PCM-verified routing.
cases.expect: GUI/tray/CLI distinguish desired configuration, observed connection and measured verified audio. Discovery/graph/build success never implies verified audio. Degraded status includes concrete reason and fix.

cases.steps: Remove or disable xrun/drop/latency/queue metrics while route remains configured/connected; separately inject a known queue overflow/discontinuity.
cases.expect: Unavailable metrics are unknown in every client/JSON, never numeric zero or healthy quality. Overflow/drop gives visible degraded/failure status despite an existing WAV or steady-tone pass.

cases.steps: Mute mic-to-Call while mic-to-Record remains unmuted and capture Record. Separately toggle hardware mic mute, Record mute, and Bluetooth headset mute; observe CLI, GUI, tray and supported call app state.
cases.expect: Unmuted Record forbids a blanket microphone-muted indicator. Hardware mute, Call-send mute and recording mute are separately named and synchronized only when actually observed. Unsupported hardware state is unknown. Media volume/buttons never silently change route gains or hijack OS player/session ownership.

cases.steps: A new user chooses mic/headphones, safe Call/Record/Monitor presets and explicit named virtual inputs in supported apps; restart/replug and recover a permission/profile failure.
cases.expect: Clear selectors, saved choices, accessible/native app/tray behavior, clear degraded reason and fix; ordinary setup needs no graph editor, terminal or global default changes. Exact supported OS/desktop/device/app versions and observed steps are recorded.
